notes.title: Beta 2B update.
notes.notes: I'm gonna be honest, I was sitting on this for a [i]while[/i] and kind of forgot about it. But i'm back to work on the game, and i'll be releasing some more updates in the future. This one should have a functional singleplayer.

notes.title: Going Free 2 Play
notes.notes:
I'm making the game free from here on out. This change should take effect sometime next month, so, if you're thinking about buying the game. Don't just yet.
I'd like to thank those who purchased during early access for their support.

notes.title: CaveGame 2.0 has begun development.
notes.notes:
